eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Los Angeles, CA; at 1:41 PM on AUG 27, 2026 Effective until 3:41 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
AN AMBER ALERT IS BEING ISSUED BY THE CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL ON BEHALF OF THE LOS ANGELES POLICE DEPARTMENT.

ON AUGUST 27, 2026, AT 11 30 AM, JAX ROBOTTOM WAS TAKEN FROM LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA.  JAX ROBOTTOM IS A 2 YEAR OLD BLACK MALE, 2 FEET 10 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 30 POUNDS, WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES.  JAX ROBOTTOM IS BELIEVED TO BE WEARING A BLUE SHIRT.

THE SUSPECT, MARCUS CLAYTON, IS A 33 YEAR OLD BLACK MALE, STANDING 5 FEET 11 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 165 POUNDS WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES.   MARCUS CLAYTON CLOTHING DESCRIPTION IS UNKNOWN.
